title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. Grothendieck presents the moduli stack of elliptic curves through the Legendre lambda-line U_{0,3} = P^1 - {0,1,inf}. M'_{1,1} = [U_{0,3}/S_3] is the stack quotient by the anharmonic S_3, with no account taken of the automorphism -1. M_{1,1} = [U_{0,3}/S~_3], where S~_3 = SL(2,Z)/M is a central extension of S_3 by mu = {+-1}. The common coarse space is the j-line E' = U_{0,3}/S_3, and the point o of E' is j = 0.

Previous page. He took the Q-point T of M'_{1,1} over o built from the splitting mu ~ {1, sigma} of S_3 -> mu. The obstruction to lifting T to M_{1,1} is the obstruction to lifting the quadratic character Pi_Q -> mu of Q(j) = Q(sqrt(-3)) through E'' = Z/4 (preimage of {1, sigma_inf} in S~_3). This is the classical embedding problem: the cup product chi ∪ chi = (-3,-1).

This page.
1. The first lines finish that remark: the obstruction is nonzero over Q and becomes trivial on passing to a suitable subgroup of Pi_Q, i.e. a suitable field extension.
2. Conclusion: that particular Q-point of M'_{1,1} does not lift to a Q-point of M_{1,1}. Its image o in E' must nevertheless lift, since curves with j = 0 such as y^2 = x^3 + 1 are defined over Q. So there should exist an S~_3-torsor P~ over Q with an S~_3-equivariant map P~ -> U_{0,3}, equivalently P = P~/mu -> U_{0,3}.
3. To see this he forms Q = U_{0,3} x_{E'} {o}, the scheme-theoretic fibre over j = 0, and P_0 = Q_red. P_0 is the pair of points lambda = -rho, -rho^2 (roots of lambda^2 - lambda + 1); the fibre is non-reduced because of ramification. Over any K containing Q(j) it is two rational points; over Q it is one closed point, so P_0 ≅ Spec Q(j) canonically.
4. S_3 stabilises P_0. The stabiliser of a point is A_3 (generated by lambda -> 1/(1-lambda)), so S_3 acts through sg: S_3 -> mu. Thus P_0 is a mu_Q-torsor, with mu acting compatibly with the Galois action.

Next page draws the consequence. Lifts of o to M'_{1,1} (resp. M_{1,1}) are equivalent to S_3- (resp. S~_3-) torsors over Q lifting the mu-torsor P_0. Equivalently, they are conjugacy classes of lifts of Gamma_Q -> mu along S_3 -> mu (resp. S~_3 -> mu), whose kernel Z/6 recovers Aut(E_0) = mu_6.

In modern terms this is an explicit Galois-cohomological description of the residual gerbe of M_{1,1} over j = 0: Q-forms of the curve with j = 0 are the sextic twists, H^1(Q, mu_6) = Q*/Q*^6, made explicit through the lambda-line presentation.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. The transcription's 'P_0 ≅ Spec Q(sqrt(-1))' must be Spec Q(j) = Q(sqrt(-3)): the fibre of the lambda-line over j = 0 is lambda^2 - lambda + 1 = 0, consistent with the previous page's 'Q(cube root of 1) = Q(j)'.

The field in line 2 is uncertain. If it is truly Q(sqrt 3), the claim would be wrong: (-3,-1) restricted to Q(sqrt 3) is (-1,-1), which is nonzero at the real places. The obstruction vanishes over Q(i) or Q(sqrt(-3)), so the reading is probably one of these.
'Ordinaires' and 'conique' in the transcription are likely misreadings ('o' as the point name; 'canoniquement').

ideas.what: Presentation of M_{1,1} as a quotient stack [lambda-line / S~_3], with S~_3 a central extension of S_3 by +-1 (from SL(2,Z)), and M'_{1,1} = [lambda-line/S_3]
ideas.modern_name: Quotient-stack presentation of M_{1,1} via level-2 (Legendre) structure
ideas.where_published: Spirit of Esquisse d'un programme (Teichmüller tower in low genus); not this explicit form as far as I know

ideas.what: Lifting rational points from coarse j-line to the stack = torsors lifting a mu-torsor / lifting Galois characters through group extensions; obstruction = embedding problem Z/4 over Q(sqrt(-3))
ideas.modern_name: Residual gerbe at j=0, sextic twists H^1(Q, mu_6), embedding-problem obstruction chi∪chi
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Weil descent / twists; embedding problems à la Witt)

deep.surprise_reason: A careful, correct but routine worked example: the fibre of the lambda-line over j = 0 and Galois descent of lifts to the stack. The content is standard (the j = 0 gerbe, sextic twists); it is pedagogically nice but contains nothing new to a specialist.
transcription_corrections: 'les points Q-rationnels ordinaires de M'_{1,1} ne se remontent pas' is more likely 'le point Q-rationnel o de M'_{1,1} ne se remonte pas'.
'schéma conique isomorphe' is likely 'schéma canoniquement isomorphe'.
'cette obstruction est striction' is probably 'devient triviale' (the obstruction becomes trivial on restriction).
The field 'Q(sqrt 3)' in line 3 is uncertain; it is probably Q(sqrt(-3)) or Q(i).
